items.title: EchoStar (ECHO) Stock Looks Hard To Call As Earnings Anchor Value
items.summary: EchoStar has delivered a very large 3 year share price gain, which puts a spotlight on whether the current US$102.20 price can still be explained by the earnings that underpin the business. With that kind of history in the rear-view mirror, the question now is how much of the company’s earnings power is already reflected in the stock. items.title: Wall Street Analysts Think EchoStar (ECHO) Could Surge 39.68%: Read This Before Placing a Bet

items.title: AT&T, T-Mobile Are Reportedly Ready To Boot Boost Mobile If SpaceX Buys It
items.summary: Semafor’s Rohan Goswami said that AT&T and T-Mobile have discussed removing Boost Mobile from their networks if SpaceX acquires the EchoStar unit, creating a potential obstacle to Elon Musk’s push to become a major U.S. wireless carrier.
